nodes.rationale: Kernel and RAYA share one Supabase project; app setup must not drop kernel schema or reset service_role grants.

nodes.label: Bluestift Cognitive Kernel

nodes.rationale: Automatic fallback so /analyze never crashes if one provider is down; raises only if both fail.

nodes.rationale: Corporate proxies intercept TLS on managed Windows machines.

nodes.rationale: Graph is open for any subject, not a fixed list; get_or_create_kc creates KCs on the fly.

nodes.label: Pedagogical-Safety Anomaly Detection

nodes.label: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing
nodes.rationale: Interpretable and auditable, works from day 1 with literature priors.

nodes.label: Cognitive Vector (K, V, P, M)

nodes.label: Open Design Tensions
nodes.rationale: Interpretability vs performance; selective-update threshold unset for K-12; M as quantifiable vector is a design decision.

nodes.label: Cross-Subject Bridges
nodes.rationale: Bridge edges let a physics struggle trace to a maths root with no detector change.

nodes.label: Kernel Moat
nodes.rationale: Root cause not symptom, cognitive x affective, auditable safety, sub-Saharan data flywheel uncopyable, open graph.

nodes.label: DFS Root-Cause by Convergence
nodes.rationale: Root chosen as the concept many failing KCs trace back to, not simply the longest chain.

nodes.label: Root-Gap Detection
nodes.rationale: Diagnose WHY a student is blocked (deepest prerequisite gap), not just where.

nodes.label: Responsible-DKT (neural-symbolic)
nodes.rationale: Hybrid DKT + symbolic rules for AUC ~0.90 while staying interpretable; data-gated upgrade.

nodes.label: Data Flywheel (priors -> self-calibration)
nodes.rationale: Static priors on day 1 become dynamic, population-calibrated parameters as RAYA collects real conversations.

nodes.rationale: service_role only, no DDL, every /analyze logged, strict Pydantic validation, free tier only.

nodes.label: Mindset M
nodes.rationale: Blend of corpus formula (abandon measured) and measured dynamics; K and forgetting excluded to avoid stereotype-threat labelling.

nodes.label: M formula correction
nodes.rationale: Abandon sign inverted and sigmoid range [0.5,0.73] made fixed impossible; fixed with centred sigmoid, gain 6, symmetric EMA 0.3.

nodes.label: ASSISTED_GUESS 0.5
nodes.rationale: Motivated by Bastani 2024: assisted practice barely predicts unassisted results.

nodes.label: Linguistic block not counted
nodes.rationale: Failure due to linguistic block not counted; ambiguous counts half.

nodes.label: Literature vs design vs transposition
nodes.rationale: Serious errors are transpositions of a result into a computation rule the source does not state.

nodes.label: No extra error asymmetry
nodes.rationale: BKT already asymmetric via slip<guess; extra rule would double count.

nodes.label: Partial credit as soft evidence
nodes.rationale: Credit c read as correct with weight c; no snapping to bins since rounding turned neutral 0.5 into mastery evidence.

nodes.label: Provenance rule (prior / design / fitted)
nodes.rationale: A prior or design constant is a placeholder until data replaces it.

nodes.label: MAP Baum-Welch BKT calibration
nodes.rationale: Always shrinks towards literature priors, never previous fit.

nodes.label: Forgetting towards p_init with spacing
nodes.rationale: K_eff = floor+(K-floor)e^(-lambda dt); each review multiplies half-life by sqrt2, a lapse cancels a review.

nodes.label: MAX_SLIP_OR_GUESS 0.45
nodes.rationale: Keeps model identifiable; at slip+guess>=1 success becomes evidence of not knowing.

nodes.label: ood_distribution detector
nodes.rationale: Compares to local population baseline, skipping uncalibrated KCs.

nodes.label: Removed selective-update gate
nodes.rationale: Drift comes from re-estimating parameters on thin data, not updating state; gate froze successful students.

nodes.label: Calibration cooldown and data gates
nodes.rationale: Refuses to fit on thin data (10+ students, 5+ interactions); null last_calibration_at means not enough evidence.

nodes.label: Living parameters
nodes.rationale: Constants start as literature priors and self-calibrate from real data via EM on learning_events.

nodes.label: App profile cache (profile-cache.ts)
nodes.rationale: Refresh only after commits plus 6h floor, so the app does not wake the sleeping kernel.

nodes.label: /ready deep health route
nodes.rationale: Startup DB probe moved here so boot does no network work.

nodes.label: commit_state: false
nodes.rationale: Avoids counting graded evidence twice when /analyze follows /update_concept_state.

nodes.label: Railway Serverless deploy cost rules
nodes.rationale: Nothing holds a connection at rest, no uptime pings, empty lifespan; keeps service ~$0.10/month.

nodes.label: /analyze rate limits
nodes.rationale: Two LLM calls per request; ceilings stop retry loops and leaked-secret abuse.

nodes.label: Two-tier auth (service secret + Supabase user token)
nodes.rationale: Bounds who may ask about whom; a leaked service secret should not be a skeleton key to every profile.
nodes.norm_label: two-tier auth (service secret + supabase user token)

nodes.label: kc_priorities layer
nodes.rationale: Bounded [0.1,5.0], applied only among valid next steps so a school cannot skip prerequisites.

nodes.label: Active probing of unverified prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Planted gap found 30-44% when practised vs 0-11% when never; RAYA probing is the biggest lever.

nodes.label: GraphRAG (graph first, retrieval last)
nodes.rationale: Only the graph knows what a concept rests on; retrieval runs last and only for graph-picked concepts. Mastered prerequisite is a wall; unknown is not mastered; order by foundation.

nodes.label: Synthetic-student evaluation benchmark
nodes.rationale: Detection quality is measured, not asserted; extraction assumed perfect so numbers are a ceiling.

nodes.label: Paged graph reads
nodes.rationale: PostgREST caps rows; a truncated graph silently makes the detector name false roots.

nodes.label: Subject-aware extraction vocabulary (VOCABULARY_BUDGET 400)
nodes.rationale: Home subject served first with a quarter held back for cross-subject, preventing label drift.

nodes.label: Kernel is extended BKT + symbolic rules, not DKT
nodes.rationale: DKT needs training data; extended BKT matches DKT (Khajah 2016); DKT gain from duplicates (Xiong 2016).
nodes.norm_label: kernel is extended bkt + symbolic rules, not dkt

nodes.label: Cold-start LLM graph distillation
nodes.rationale: LLM supplies structure (nodes+edges); real student data later calibrates parameters - the flywheel.

nodes.rationale: App reads it directly for dashboards so a sleeping kernel is not woken per page view.
